subject: english
question: Which of the following best captures the central theme of the passage?

options.text: The influence of peer pressure on teens
Cosmetic beauty norms and fashion trends
Hidden psychological battles due to digital aesthetics
The necessity of academic counseling for teens

solution:
The correct answer is: Hidden psychological battles due to digital aesthetics. 

This option is correct because the passage highlights the psychological struggles teens face due to unrealistic beauty standards promoted by digital platforms.
